en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Modern patriotic song, origin unclear (I cannot name an author). Chento is Metodija Andonov-Cento, first president of ASNOM, which met at the Prohor Pcinski monastery in 1944.

lines.cyr: Среде Скопје мнозина ми се собраа,
lines.lat: Srede Skopje mnozina mi se sobraa,
lines.en: In the middle of Skopje many gathered,
they asked for the truth about Chento:
- Where is Chento, hey, tell us,

lines.cyr: дојде време вистината да се дознае.
lines.lat: dojde vreme vistinata da se doznae.
lines.en: the time has come for the truth to be learned.
- Where is Chento, hey, tell us,

lines.cyr: дојде време вистината, ајде, да се сознае.
lines.lat: dojde vreme vistinata, ajde, da se soznae.
lines.en: the time has come for the truth, come on, to be known.

lines.cyr: Среде Скопје мнозина ми се собраа,
lines.lat: Srede Skopje mnozina mi se sobraa,
lines.en: In the middle of Skopje many gathered,
they asked about the monastery of Prohor Pcinski.

lines.cyr: В' манастирот Прохор Пчински, таму започна
lines.lat: V' manastirot Prohor Pčinski, tamu započna
lines.en: In the monastery of Prohor Pcinski, there began

lines.cyr: нова борба за слобода, за Македонија.
lines.lat: nova borba za sloboda, za Makedonija.
lines.en: a new struggle for freedom, for Macedonia.

lines.cyr: В' манастирот Прохор Пчински, таму започна
lines.lat: V' manastirot Prohor Pčinski, tamu započna
lines.en: In the monastery of Prohor Pcinski, there began

lines.cyr: нова борба македонска, ајде, за Македонија.
lines.lat: nova borba makedonska, ajde, za Makedonija.
lines.en: a new Macedonian struggle, come on, for Macedonia.
Oh, Macedonian people, do not forget

lines.cyr: што си имал, што си губел, што си започнал.
lines.lat: što si imal, što si gubel, što si započnal.
lines.en: what you had, what you lost, what you began.

lines.cyr: И да имаш сила јака, сила голема,
lines.lat: I da imaš sila jaka, sila golema,
lines.en: And even if you have a mighty strength, a great strength,

lines.cyr: пак ќе бидеш, земјо мила, наша најмила.
lines.lat: pak ḱe bideš, zemjo mila, naša najmila.
lines.en: you will be again, dear land, our dearest.
